title: Intermediate personal.yml (contract v1)
description: One entry per Personal/* page in the graph, keyed by slug (lowercased, spaces to underscores, & to 'and'). Deliberately open-ended: the Personal page is the site's distinguishing feature and its content is not a fixed schema. Phase 5 renders it from _data/personal.yml.

propertyNames.description: Page slug, e.g. music, cycling_and_hiking, diy, reading.
Slug of a '## Header' in the page, or _root for entries before the first header.

page.description: Page-level properties other than title/description/sections are passed through verbatim, each either a plain string or a {id, url} link object.

_name.description: The block's own title text. Underscore-prefixed because it comes from block content rather than a property.

sectionEntry.description: One block under a section header, with its Logseq properties passed through. Third-party embeds (Spotify, SoundCloud, Wikiloc) arrive as link objects and must degrade to a plain link when unavailable — D19.

propertyValue.description: A markdown link in the graph becomes {id, url}; anything else stays a string with [[brackets]] stripped.
